requirement: Render a non-negative duration in f-strings through __format__ with a compact default form, a zero-padded clock form and a total-seconds form, rejecting unknown specs and negative durations, and make str match the default form.
skeleton: Frozen Duration dataclass with __post_init__ validation, __format__ branching on the spec after divmod into hours, minutes and seconds, and __str__ delegating to format.
caption: A value type that controls its own rendering in f-strings by implementing __format__, built on the standard-library dataclasses module. Duration is a frozen dataclass holding a whole number of seconds; __post_init__ raises ValueError saying the duration must not be negative, while zero is allowed. __format__(spec) splits the seconds with divmod into hours, the remaining seconds, then minutes and seconds from that remainder. An empty spec renders a compact form: the hours part like 1h only when hours is non-zero, the minutes part whenever hours or minutes is non-zero so 3600 seconds reads 1h 0m 0s, and the seconds part always, joined by spaces. The clock spec renders zero-padded hours, minutes and seconds separated by colons without wrapping hours at 24. The s spec renders the total seconds. Any other spec raises ValueError naming the repr of the unknown format spec. __str__ delegates to format with an empty spec so str and f-strings agree. The fixture asserts the default rendering of 3723, 59, 0, 120, 3600 and 3605 seconds, that str of 61 seconds is 1m 1s, that clock renders 01:02:03, 25:01:01 and 00:00:05, that the s spec renders 3723, that the spec x raises ValueError, and that a negative duration raises ValueError.

plan.intent: Print durations readably in several styles
constraints: Negative durations raise ValueError and zero renders as 0s
The default form shows minutes whenever hours are shown
The clock form does not wrap hours at 24
str matches the default f-string rendering

rationale.teaches: Implementing __format__ to interpret format specs, with divmod decomposition and a strict fallback for unknown specs.
rationale.why: Hand-built duration strings drop zero components or reuse the total in divmod, and a permissive fallback hides typos in format specs until someone reads the output.

ops.docstring: A duration type that understands its own format specs in f-strings.

candidates.why_wrong: Minutes come from the total seconds, so 3723 seconds shows 62 minutes after the hour.
A zero minute count after a non-zero hour is dropped, so 3600 renders as 1h 0s.
Hours wrap at 24 in the clock form, so a 25 hour duration reads 01.
Unknown specs fall back to total seconds instead of raising, hiding format typos.
A zero duration is rejected even though only negative durations are invalid.
